Confirm permitted commercial use of catalog/API/materials; third-party wallet support is not a blanket scraping or image license.

Keep trading, brokerage, rental-income claims and property redemption outside this integration.

free_infrastructure.capability: Free plan documents node, token, NFT and transfer data APIs within quotas; current SVaultAI NFT endpoint access was not separately tested.
No-key public RPC used for bounded watch-contract reads. No SLA or unlimited-production guarantee asserted.
No-key algod/indexer; documented quotas and backoff requirements apply. One public issuer-linked property asset query succeeded.

user_action_now: No paid API, token purchase or credential sharing is required for this research. Approve issuer choices/customer-country scope before enabling a particular asset; issuer confirmations are needed where current registry, rights or integration permission are missing.
safest_next_implementation: Extend closed Ethereum ERC-20 support for explicitly selected KMS KAG, with live issuer controls and upgrade fencing; keep other categories unavailable until their specific verification/integration requirements are satisfied.
rollout_boundary: User explicitly authorized implementation and making connectable assets live. Preserve existing crypto and other features, use scoped tested rollback, and independently verify the deployed release. No buying, selling, swaps, fiat, custody, physical-token minting or issuer redemption is added.
